100 Years Ago Today, This is What Was Happening ...

On August 8, 1926, the world was abuzz with news of the ongoing diplomatic tensions in Europe, particularly as France and Germany grappled with reparations from World War I. In the United States, the film industry continued to flourish with the rise of talkies, captivating audiences and transforming cinema. Meanwhile, in the realm of sports, American swimmer Gertrude Ederle was making headlines as she prepared for her historic attempt to swim the English Channel, aiming to be the first woman to achieve the feat.
